title: Kuch Nahi Hua
text:
Main: Kya hua?
Wo: Kuch nahi.
Main: Sach me kuch nahi?
Wo: Bilkul kuch nahi.
Dosto, "kuch nahi" hi sabse badi problem hoti hai. 💔

title: Tum Decide Karo
text:
Wo: Khaane me kya banau?
Main: Jo tumhara mann kare.
Wo: Nahi, tum batao.
Main: Paneer.
Wo: Roz paneer? Kuch naya socho.
Sawal tha ya trap, aaj tak samajh nahi aaya. 🍲

title: Bas Do Minute
text:
Wo: Bas do minute, ek dukaan aur.
Do ghante baad.
Wo: Bas do minute, ek dukaan aur.
Physics me time relative hota hai —
shopping me proof mil jaata hai. 🛍️

title: Purani Baat
text:
Ladkiyon ki memory itni acchi hoti hai
ki 2019 ki chhoti si baat 2026 ke argument me
exact date aur time ke saath aa jaati hai.
Google ko competition mil gaya. 📅

title: Movie Kaunsi Dekhein
text:
Movie choose karne me 1 ghanta.
Movie ki length 2 ghanta.
Dekhi 20 minute,
phir dono ne phone dekhna shuru kar diya.
Modern romance. 🎬

title: Pehla Pyaar
text:
Pehla pyaar Maths jaisa hota hai.
Samajh me aaye toh zindagi aasaan,
na aaye toh poori life supplementary. 📐

title: Propose Karne Se Pehle
text:
Maine 3 mahine practice ki.
Aaine ke saamne 200 baar bola.
Saamne aate hi nikla:
"Aap… yahan… kaise… hello." 🌹

title: Gift ka Hint
text:
Wo: Mujhe kuch nahi chahiye.
Main: Sach me?
Wo: Haan, bas wo wali cheez jo maine 8 baar dikhayi thi.
Hint itna subtle tha ki radar bhi miss kar deta. 🎁

title: Selfie ka Angle
text:
Usne 60 selfie li.
Sabhi me main hi kharaab aa raha tha.
Karan: main camera ki taraf dekh hi nahi raha tha,
main uske phone ki battery dekh raha tha. 🤳

title: Long Distance
text:
Long distance relationship ka sabse bada dushman
na doori hai, na time zone —
balki 2 bar network. 📵

title: Tumhe Kuch Yaad Hai?
text:
Wo: Aaj kya din hai?
Main: Mangalwar.
Wo: Aur?
Main: 16 tareekh.
Wo: Aur?
Main: Bhai, calendar ban gaya hoon par jawab galat hi hai. 📆

title: Ex ka Status
text:
Move on ka matlab hai
ki ab uska status dekhne ke baad
dil nahi dukhta —
bas thoda sa internet data kharch hota hai. 📱

title: Shaadi Ke Baad
text:
Shaadi se pehle: "Tum jo chaho dekho."
Shaadi ke baad: remote kahan hai, ye bhi permission ka mudda hai.
Pyaar wahi hai, bas democracy badal gayi. 📺

title: Hum Dost Hi Achhe Hain
text:
Duniya ka sabse mehnat wala kaam:
"Hum ache dost hain" sun kar
muskurate rehna. 🙂

title: Naraz Hone ka Formula
text:
Reply late = naraz.
Reply jaldi = "matlab busy nahi the?"
Reply na karo = "ab toh koi matlab hi nahi."
Is equation ka koi solution nahi hai. ➗

title: Pyaar aur Budget
text:
Pyaar me paisa nahi dekha jaata —
ye baat har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko sach lagti hai
aur 25 tareekh ko dobara sochni padti hai. 💸
